create_qwen_model: create a Qwen TransformerLM model from a QwenConfig using create_qwen_model
build_qwen_factory: build a QwenFactory instance with a QwenConfig to construct model components incrementally
create_qwen_decoder: create a TransformerLMDecoder with rotary position encoding and GLU feed-forward layers via QwenFactory
create_qwen_embedding: create a VocabShardedEmbedding with truncated normal initialization for the Qwen model
init_truncated_normal: initialize a weight tensor and optional bias with truncated normal distribution and zero bias
